description: Saw Spencer go in alone, and asked about tomorrow's fire.
name: Alse Pinder

description: The sixty shillings are for home. They were not sent.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: The twenty shillings are her quarter. She was not in the room.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said Norwich, and refused any other town.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Passed toward Crosby Place. He did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Gave the grace, and blessed the house on the way out.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Two pounds since August are still out. He was not asked.
name: Richard Quiney

description: Said it, and did not add a figure.
name: William Shakespeare
